description: Land Settlement Department - Walaswea, Galewela D/S Division, Matale District   - Cad. Map No. 310085
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, cadastral map references, locations, and ownership details. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
